name: Audit Chain Verification

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: An audit entry is altered or deleted without detection, or a recorded hash cannot be recomputed from the persisted entry.
foreseeableSequence: privileged or erroneous UPDATE/DELETE on the chain
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Loss of non-repudiation and legal traceability of clinical acts.

controls.name: Append-only audit chain (no UPDATE/DELETE grants) with an in-database verifier that recomputes every hash (pnpm audit:verify)

invariants.statement: Audit chain entries are append-only and each stored hash is recomputable from the persisted entry and its predecessor; any alteration is detectable.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
